fixedC.enemyPlacement: BATTLE_CreateVsEnemy swaps enemy Entry[0..4] with Entry[5..9] after Enemy creation
fixedC.defaultPet: BATTLE_PetDefaultEntry places one living default pet after its owner; player pet therefore occupies slot +5

productBoundary.battleIndex: browser runtime uses null transient identifier; no server battle pool is fabricated
productBoundary.persistentState: only Idle mode changes; battle context is transient
productBoundary.entryInit: Only fields explicitly written by EntryInit are mirrored as defaults; charaindex is represented by browser characterId.
